name: llava-bench-in-the-wild-ja
description:
This dataset is the data that corrected the translation errors and untranslated data of the Japanese data in MBZUAI/multilingual-llava-bench-in-the-wild.
Original dataset is liuhaotian/llava-bench-in-the-wild.
reputation: A localized/corrected Japanese subset of a community multimodal benchmark (llava-bench-in-the-wild); modest but growing adoption among researchers evaluating Japanese MLLMs.
